name: xTool M2
notes: Blue lasers: 445 nm. Infrared: 1064 nm, for metal and some plastics. Max speed 600 mm/s. Thickest cut at 100 % power: basswood plywood 8 / 10 / 15 mm, black acrylic 3 / 8 / 11 mm (10 / 20 / 40 W). The M2 also takes a CMYK inkjet module (printing, not a laser) and has no blade cutter.
source: Image modes: values read from projects saved by xTool Studio (2026-11-27). xTool M2 FAQ, https://support.xtool.com/article/3324 (work area per module, wavelengths, max speed, max cutting thickness), read 2026-11-26. Unverified: which operations each module can do. Cutting with the blue lasers is confirmed by the cutting tables; score/engrave for them, and score/engrave without cut for the infrared laser, are assumptions. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension JS002 (exts/JS002), read 2026-11-26: device code and laser strings; its per-module table gives 426 x 320 (10 / 20 W), 426 x 308-312 (40 W) and 426 x 310 for laser_red_3W (the FAQ says 412 x 310, kept here).
